info.description: Raw click event on an affiliate link. Populated by the public /affiliate-tracking/click endpoint. Used later for last-touch attribution at signup time.

referralCode.description: The code as sent by the client. Not a relation — clicks on stale / rotated / unknown codes are still recorded (for fraud analytics) but the click's `affiliate` relation stays null.

affiliate.description: Denormalised — resolved at ingest so downstream queries don't have to join on the code string. Null when the code did not resolve to an active affiliate.

ipHash.description: SHA-256 of (IP + REFERRAL_IP_SALT). Raw IP is never stored. Used only for fraud clustering + rate-limit accounting, never exposed via any user-facing endpoint.

country.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2. Populated best-effort from x-vercel-ip-country / cf-ipcountry; null if not present.

landingPath.description: Path the user landed on. Query-string stripped on server-side to avoid storing PII / auth tokens that clients might accidentally forward.
